create_coordinator_instance: create a Coordinator instance with a simulator, task manager, and device settings to manage AndroidEnv interaction
execute_adb_call: execute an ADB call by passing an AdbRequest protobuf to the coordinator and receive an AdbResponse
run_rl_reset: run an RL episode reset that relaunches the simulator if needed and returns a dm_env TimeStep
run_rl_step: run an RL step by executing an agent action on the simulator and returning observation and reward
get_action_spec: get the action specification dictionary defining valid RL actions including finger count and key events
